services.desc: The museum offers a variety of programs for adults throughout the year. For Special Events please be sure to check out our Events page. The Molly Brown House Museum offers a number of adult-oriented programs on the life and times of Margaret Brown. Our programs have traveled to libraries, book clubs, senior centers, women’s groups and much more! Programs are available both in-person and virtually. The Art of Victorian Dining Put on your finest gown or tuxedo and take a step back in time to discuss the importance of dining in Victorian America. services.desc: Our homeschool programs encourage learners to ask big questions, investigate the past, and discover history through hands-on experiences. From curriculum-aligned social studies classes to family workshops, field trips, and exclusive teen experiences, the Molly Brown House Museum becomes a living classroom where history comes to life. Whether you’re supplementing your curriculum or simply nurturing a love of learning, there’s something for every curious historian! Explore history together! Take learning beyond the page with guided field trips to discover the people, places, and stories that shaped Colorado.
